title: Dirty Teacher
description: After a high school senior learns her boyfriend is having an affair with a teacher, she becomes the victim of an elaborate frame-up.

title: Cellmate Secrets
description:
S01 E05 — Susan Smith
Susan was convicted of killing her two sons; now her cellmates are revealing all, including how they helped her procure drugs and kept her sexual relationships a secret; Alfred and Elizabeth Rowe detail Alfred's inappropriate encounters with Susan.

title: A Professor's Vengeance
description: When Nicole Atkins returns to graduate school, a previous affair with a married professor is the last thing on her mind. However, someone else on campus has his eye on Nicole, someone who knows all her secrets.

title: Bad Tutor
description: Single mom Karen is focused on getting daughter Emily graduated and off to college. When she hires Devin to boost Emily's grades, the tutor becomes dangerously obsessed.

title: Deadly Cheers
description: A high school cheerleading coach will stop at nothing to cover up the accidental death of a student -- even if it means murder.

title: Deadly Debutante
description: A sinister young woman will do whatever it takes to be chosen Belle of the Ball at an annual debutante ball.

title: Deadly Influencer
description: A young woman commits murder to keep her classmates' social media careers under her thumb. After killing a popular friend, she turns her sights on a new girl, but the girl's mother suspects the truth and will fight to protect her daughter.

title: Cellmate Secrets
description:
S01 E04 — Chris Watts
Christa Richello is convinced Chris Watts is innocent and is writing a book with him and her now-fiancé, Dylan; Christa delves into her relationship with the two men, and Cheryln Cadle reveals information the FBI doesn't know.

description: After a woman enrolls in an auto racing school, her mentally unstable instructor falls in love with her and tries to roll over everybody in her life.

description: A 17-year-old honor student gets into a drunken driving accident after her boyfriend's parents allow alcohol to be served to minors in their home.

title: Pretty Little Addict
description: After losing her father to cancer, Jennifer's drinking leads to a tragic accident that leaves a college-bound track star unable to walk. Now in rehab, Jennifer believes she's getting her life back on track until someone comes seeking revenge.

title: Cellmate Secrets
description:
S01 E06 — Shayna Hubers
Shayna Hubers shot and killed her boyfriend, Ryan Poston; now Holly Nivens details how Shayna manipulated her into believing it was self-defense; Cecily Miller details Shayna's behavior after her arrest; Carissa details how Ryan wanted out.

title: The Secret Lives of College Freshmen
description: A college freshman moves into the perfect dorm on campus, but soon discovers the previous resident died under mysterious circumstances. Believing the girl was murdered, she tries to uncover the identity of the killer before it's too late.

title: Secret Life of a Sorority Girl
description: Single mother Cheryl is determined to find her missing daughter Ashley, who was working as a pole dancer at a nightclub to pay for college. Cheryl gets a job at the club to search for clues.

title: Secret Lives of College Escorts
description: A 19-year-old college student meets a successful event planner who offers her a seemingly perfect job to pay for tuition. However, she soon discovers the opportunity is nothing more than a front for a dangerous scheme that caused her friend's death.
